title: Employees Are People Too
coreMove: Replace process-first control with one humanizing question that restores dignity before judging performance.
sourcePressure: Moves from factory-bell control to the claim that employees are not process attachments. Humane recognition is operational because dignity changes judgment, candor, and responsibility.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing the chapter to be nicer to staff while leaving the system blind to context and dignity.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.stakes: drivers are skipping breaks and hiding injuries
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she circles one route time and writes the driver's dialysis appointment beside it before changing the schedule
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a laminated route sheet clipped to a cracked dashboard

exampleSpecs.audience: lab owner watching remake rates rise
exampleSpecs.stakes: technicians are treated as hands attached to tools
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he pulls a remake tray to the bench and asks what the wax pattern hid about the client's bite
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a row of porcelain crowns under a task lamp

exampleSpecs.audience: terminal manager after a missed sailing
exampleSpecs.stakes: staff are being blamed for a storm backlog
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the manager asks the agent what each passenger had been promised before rewriting the delay script
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a tide board beside a stack of refund vouchers

exampleSpecs.stakes: burned-out volunteers are becoming curt with adopters
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she reads the intake log aloud with the dog names still attached before discussing throughput
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a leash clipped to an intake clipboard

exampleSpecs.stakes: line cooks are treated like replaceable speed units
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the chef swaps the prep chart for a station walk where each cook names the bottleneck in their hands
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a tray of untrimmed fennel beside a dull knife

exampleSpecs.stakes: guards are exhausted and missing small signals
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the coordinator watches one guard scan the deep end for ninety seconds before changing the rotation plan
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a rescue tube against wet tile

skillTargets: spot when a rule is treating a person as a unit
add context without excusing poor work
explain why humane treatment improves responsibility
